prototype_temperature_stops.basis: Retained conservative C1 body80C prototype stop for new1000V R76. Individual stops take precedence over grouped85C screen; actual ripple/waveforms and manufacturer derating still apply.

height_limit: Planning envelope requires R24 manual forming acceptance <=17.5mm; external F1/HHT holder, cables and supports excluded. Physical fit not measured.
input_RMS_current: Not measured. R2 surrogate input current cannot be asserted unchanged after adding protection. PF is unknown.

L1.kind: 100ohm2W pulse resistor, legacy L1 location; R10 in calculations

OVP.action: TLV1812 comparator drives independent MCR12DSNT4G latched crowbar; required upstream SIBA F1 interrupts supply.
OVP.dynamic_response: Conditional model only: fault-to-effective-crowbar<=150us and F1 total interruption<=26ms require prototype verification. No guarantee of LED survival.

status: Engineering candidate with incomplete PCB routing. NOT ready for fabrication or powered tests.
power_budget_basis: Approximate fixed total-current allocation:135.203mA internal total,127.394mA external LED at60V internal bus. Protection displaces LED power.1.6–2.1W loss is a planning estimate, not a measured or guaranteed result.
nominal_voltage_basis: C6 internal bus60V; external terminal voltage includes the nominal2ohm R24 drop.

OCP.action: Second independent comparator channel shares diode OR and crowbar; senses external LED return only.

required_external_fuse.connection: Incoming LINE -> F1 -> J1.1 -> RF1; F1 is not fitted to PCB.
required_external_fuse.availability: Exact stock not confirmed; do not substitute generic250VAC fuse.

current_extended_sensitivity_scope: Inherited R2 total regulated-current sensitivity model, not external R3 LED current. R3 shunt/bias/bleeders redistribute total current; actual R3 load sensitivity remains to be validated.
